Dialogs.Dialog: "Dear"!? Don't tell me, another goodbye kiss!?
Huh!? What are you talking about？
I know we're newlyweds, but every day is embarrassing！
Ow... Huh, I got my dream all mixed up...
I saw on the news that someone stranded on an island for ages finally got rescued.
...It's good, sure, but why are YOU so relieved？ Do you know them？
No... but being stranded is rough. If no one came, they'd have to become Adam and Eve on that island...
Adam and Eve？ Did you eat something bad？
Don't worry！ I'll protect you, ▲小早川＊▲！
Yeah, yeah... I'm going on ahead, Adam.
Oh yeah, the other day I saw an abandoned cat...
One that looked just like ▲小早川＊▲？
Huh？ Looked like Rinko？ Are you into that kind of thing？
Next you'll want me in cat ears and a tail. ...Pervert.
Oh yeah, my little brother watches a magical girl anime, even though he's a boy...
Don't tell me... "Lucky Magical Girl Rinko"!?
I don't think so... You're into that？ And her name's Rinko...
No, I mean... you know, Rinko's dad is a daruma doll！
You used to play with dolls when you were little, ▲小早川＊▲？
Yeah？ I was home alone a lot...
Well... no. I have Dad and Mom and my brother, and friends... and you too, I guess.
...I see. That's good... Yeah, yeah, I won't let you feel lonely ever again！
Why are you tearing up!? I don't get it at all！
...Sorry to interrupt, but Rinko's going now. Take care of yourself.
You did great, Rintaro！ Keep protecting the Earth with Volvavin！ Go！ Volve Fuuuu～
...Ugh... Good thing it wasn't the missiles...
▲小早川＊▲. You're the real ▲小早川＊▲... right？
This conversation might still be part of my dream...
Just hypothetically... if I suddenly disappeared, would you cry for me？
You didn't have to answer that fast...
I'm not crying for someone who says dumb stuff like that.
Geez, stop it. No more gloomy what-ifs.
I watched the Killer Bambis DVD again...
More than anything, you feel the unity between the stage and the crowd.
...You get it. Though I don't get why you're suddenly interested...
I brought you Valentine's chocolate. Here. I am your girlfriend, after all.
...It's nothing to get that excited about. It's just one of those events.
Is that so？ Getting it from ▲小早川＊▲ honestly makes me happy.
Then I guess lining up to buy it was worth it...
W-Well, I was shopping anyway. ...It just caught my eye...
I see, thanks. Guess I'll have to go all out for White Day.
...Oh, there's that too. I see. Okay. I'm counting on you, then.
Ah... No use acting all calm. Rinko sees right through you.
If you had a girlfriend and didn't get any, you'd be pitiful, right？ So...
Aren't you going to give it to me？
Just handing it over is no fun, so say, "Please！ Give me chocolate, Lady Rinko！"
I thought about it a lot, and went back and forth, and... see you！
Today's Valentine's, right？ I figured you might be waiting for chocolate.
Of course I am. I'm your girlfriend. Here.
Homemade？ Wow, you really worked hard...
It was a lot of work, so savor it. Hehe.
Yeah. And... I'm expecting something on White Day, okay？
For me？ ...Could this be Valentine's chocolate？
It's nothing. You've kind of helped me out a little.
So ▲小早川＊▲ does this kind of thing too.
Being all cynical, or going on about candy-industry conspiracies, is more childish, if anything.
That's all I wanted. See you...
Last month was the guys, this month's the girls. Getting fidgety over it is silly, though.
So here's my return gift. I was actually nervous about when to give it to you.
You were timing it？ That's kind of funny.
(She didn't seem very happy with it...)
Hey, wasn't this kind of a hassle？
On Valentine's, was it a hassle for ▲小早川＊▲？
Then it wasn't a hassle for me either. It was fun, if anything.
Yeah... I think I get that.
So don't be shy, take it.
Okay, pop quiz. What day is it today？
Hmm. So you actually got me something？
I'm happy you got me something, but... this one's a no.
(She didn't seem very happy with it...)
But more than the gift, I'm happy you remembered.
Hey, was it like that for you on Valentine's？
Well... yeah. Giving and getting stuff at these events is kind of fun.
Yeah. You get ready way in advance, and the day before your heart's pounding...
So I'm the only one whose heart was pounding.
Huh!? Um... actually, Rinko was... kind of...
▲小早川＊▲. What timing. I was just about to come find you.
Is it White Day stuff, after all？
Yeah, I've got your return gift, of course.
Wow, thank you！ I'm so happy！
Maybe I got my hopes up too much...
(She didn't seem very happy with it...)
But it's a little sad that this means it's over.
During these events, thinking about what to give and what I'd get was fun.
It is fun, sure. Every month would be rough, though.
It doesn't have to cost money... No, never mind.
These things are special because they only come a few times a year.
Besides, I get lots of things from you that aren't objects. That alone makes Rinko happy.
Your return gift for Valentine's. Today's White Day, right？
That's why I'm giving one back. Not sure if you'll like it, though.
Oh... You're better at this than I thought.
(She didn't seem very happy with it...)
Oh, White Day, huh. No wonder the girls were all fidgety.
Weren't you looking forward to it, ▲小早川＊▲？
Not so much looking forward. I forgot.
I see. But I bet some people confess on days like this.
...Just so you know, if you're expecting that kind of thing from me, forget it.
Mine's just a thank-you for always looking out for me.
(Oh no！ It's White Day and I didn't get her anything...)
Sorry！ I actually didn't get you a White Day gift！
(I'm the biggest idiot in the land！)
(Oh no！ It's White Day and I didn't get her anything...)
▲主人公＊▲. Hehe, what's with the dopey face？
Sorry！ I actually didn't get you a White Day gift！
(I'm the biggest idiot in the land！)
(Oh no！ It's White Day and I didn't get her anything...)
Hehe, my White Day gift. I couldn't wait, so I came to you.
Sorry！ I actually didn't get you a White Day gift！
Geez, forget it. I was looking forward to it...
(I'm the biggest idiot in the land！)
(Oh no！ It's White Day and I didn't get her anything...)
Sorry！ I actually didn't get you a White Day gift！
...It's fine. Not like I was expecting anything.
I said it's fine. See you...
(I'm the biggest idiot in the land！)
Obviously. Sports festivals are nothing but depressing.
Even if you're bad at sports, you can cheer for your friends.
Then at least say something to someone who's about to compete？
Well, yeah. Pretty impressive, I guess？ Not that I'd want to copy it.
Well, it's not like being good at sports is everything...
I just heard. You're in the Mr. Handsome Contest？
The guys signed me up without asking. I just found out...
Then you've got nothing to lose. Just go for it？
Easy for you to say... Aren't you entering the Miss Beauty Contest, ▲小早川＊▲？
No？ I think you'd do pretty well. You might even win.
▲小早川＊▲. Could it be that I'm... good-looking？
Don't get too full of yourself.
(Taking care of my looks paid off...)
Don't get down. Who cares about stuff like that.
Looks are just one part of what makes a person attractive.
(Still, maybe I should pay more attention to my looks...)
No？ You're in a dress today. It suits you.
Um, so, maybe a present or... something.
(She didn't seem very happy with it...)
A present？ You mean Santa Claus？
(Oops, should I have gotten her a present？)
Hey... there's somewhere I want you to come with me...
Oh, merry... Never mind, skip that stuff.
Haha. A dress today... It suits you.
Hey. I got you a present？
Oh, this. I wanted this... nice！
Huh, this works too, I guess.
(She didn't seem very happy with it...)
What？ ▲小早川＊▲ still believes in Santa？
(Oops, should I have gotten her a present？)
Hey, will you come with me after this？
I'm kind of tired. I'm going home...
Merry Christmas！ You're in a dress today. It suits you.
Hey, of course you got me a present, right？
Oh, I really wanted this！ Thank you！
(She didn't seem very happy with it...)
Haha, are you hanging up a stocking tonight？
(Oops, should I have gotten her a present？)
Hey, will you come somewhere with Rinko after this？
Rinko shouldn't be out late, so she's heading home.
I'm just the same as always.
No dress or anything？ It would suit you.
Huh... The lights really change the atmosphere.
In the end it's just light bulbs wrapped around stuff... but like this, it's something else entirely.
Are you a little giddy, ▲小早川＊▲？
What's that, makes no sense. Aren't YOU the giddy one？
But if Rinko's cool inside when it's this cold out, she might freeze, huh？
Then I'd better warm you up. Can you come a little closer？
It'd be nice if we could see it together again next year.
Wow... It's not just the scenery. Even the air feels different from usual.
It really is a special day.
On days like this, maybe even miracles happen.
Who knows. Is there a miracle you're hoping for, ▲小早川＊▲？
Well, Rinko's human too. She's got a material want or two.
Material wants... Ask Santa for those.
Santa only goes to kids. Besides, he doesn't exist.
Then should I be Santa for you today？
Huh？ What are you... Fine, go on？
It might be something I can make happen, right？ It's free to just say it.
Even Santa's got some savings... Not a lot, though.
Can I get close to you？
Wow... It's the usual scenery, but lighting it up makes it look so different...
It really is. Like another world.
Yeah, it's kind of magical... And it feels kind of warm. Maybe because we're together...
Before I met you, I'd never have felt like this...
Me too. Alone, I might have walked right past this view.
Hey... how's Rinko now？ Worthy of being your girlfriend？
Yeah. The old ▲小早川＊▲ was cute too, but the ▲小早川＊▲ of today is the best.
Yeah, thanks. But... when you put it that way, I still feel kind of anxious.
If you say old Rinko was good too, it makes the Rinko of today lose confidence.
But they're both ▲小早川＊▲, aren't they？
Rinko's not the old Rinko anymore. She decided to change so she could be with you.
...Even so... you still love me the same as before, right？
And I'll keep loving ▲小早川＊▲ the same, however she changes.
Rinko might have just changed again.
I love you even more now... And I'll probably keep loving you more and more...
Brr... She should be here soon.
Happy New Year. Here's to another year, ▲小早川＊▲.
A kimono, huh. It suits you.
Okay, let's go make our New Year's shrine visit.
I don't want my friends seeing us like this.
Not that. It'd look like we're showing off being lovey-dovey from day one. That's lame.
It doesn't fit Rinko's cool image. That's just how it is！
Leave it to New Year's. The shrine's so packed we can't move.
But since we came all this way, I at least want to say a prayer.
Right. Let's try to get up front somehow.
Come on, let's go. If we don't hold hands, we'll get separated.
By the way, how much do you put in the offering box？ 10 yen？ 100 yen？
I think... 5 yen, "go-en," for good connections. And 25 for double connections, or something like that.
Then since we're already connected, we put in 55 yen.
Five and five, so our connection keeps going.
Here's to us, from now on...
Then let's head to the shrine.
No？ I want one, so I'll go buy it. Want to split it？
...Yeah. Well, if that's the case, I'll have some.
Come to think of it, no... You interested？
It's too much trouble to do myself, but watching might be fun.
You should try it. In a loincloth.
It really is. Glad we came.
Yeah. I thought fireworks would be boring... but the real thing is different...
Let's start with the stalls. Anything you want to eat or play？
Anything's fine. The night is long.
Ah, living things are kind of... Looking after them later is a pain.
Then... that one. The shooting gallery.
Hmm. None of the prizes interest me...
Yeah. That's probably safest. There's stuff you can only eat at festivals.
...Were you planning to go to the food stalls from the start？
It's fine, it's fine. I want to eat too.
Then you should've just said so. Guess I'll come along.
Bon dancing... I haven't since I danced with Mom and Dad when I was little...
I had no idea how to dance, so I just copied everyone and flapped my arms.
Little ▲小早川＊▲... I'd have liked to see that.
I am not！ So it's been a while？
Yeah. I haven't joined in years.
Then want to give it a try？
Huh, no way. Rinko still doesn't know how to dance！
Then just flap around. I'll back you up.
Geez... I'm really counting on you？
Oh, it's already started. We have to hurry.
Right. The stairs are dark, so be careful.
Hidden gem, right？ You get the best view of the fireworks from here.
A yukata, fireworks, and you. Might be the best combo for Rinko.
Just that the fireworks are pretty.
(I hope we can come together next year too...)
If it's late, I worry, you know.
Then let's go to the Bay Bridge.
It really is. Glad we came.
Yeah. I thought fireworks would be boring... but the real thing is different...
Oh, it's already started. We have to hurry.
Right. The stairs are dark, so be careful.
Hidden gem, right？ You get the best view of the fireworks from here.
A yukata, fireworks, and you. Might be the best combo for Rinko.
Just that the fireworks are pretty.
(I hope we can come together next year too...)
If it's late, I worry, you know.
I know that without you telling me... Sigh.
What？ Low energy right at the start of term？
Only people without a care in the world can be excited on a day like this...
Hey, why are you so giddy？
Being giddy is fine, but do your library committee work properly.
(The library's open during break, after all...)
Tests are just one of those things where doing well beats not, that's all.
...There are values in this world that school tests can't measure...
(This time's tests were neither good nor bad... Just average.)
Whether you do well or badly, nothing changes anyway.
Is that so. How'd you do？
Low test scores don't change anything.
...I'll try to think of it that way. What about you？
So-so. Once they're over, tests are no big deal.
It's your... birthday today, right？ Happy birthday.
...What else could I do？ I am your girlfriend, sort of.
And here, a present. No guarantees you'll like it.
▲小早川＊▲ picked it out, right？ I'm sure I'll like it.
...I hope so... Are you, like, happy？
Of course. Thank you so much, ▲小早川＊▲...
Today's your birthday, right？ So, um, happy birthday.
You can be happier about it. Rinko even went to the trouble of getting a present.
I agonized over it, which isn't like me at all. Be grateful, or else.
Thank you so much, ▲小早川＊▲. You put a lot of thought into this for me...
Ah, geez！ Why am I so embarrassed...
Happy birthday. I wanted to be the first to say it. Did someone beat me to it？
Don't worry, you're the first, ▲小早川＊▲.
I see. Good... Oh, Rinko brought you a present.
Rinko's happy to see your happy face too.
Maybe that's why people give presents. To see that kind of face.
You forgot... Oh well, here, this is for you.
▲小早川＊▲ is giving me something!? I never expected that. Thanks.
Just you remembering my birthday is moving enough...
I just happened to remember. You're so dramatic...
Today's your birthday, right？ Happy birthday.
And I've got a present too.
(She didn't seem very happy with it...)
Anyway, I'll at least say thanks. Thank you.
It's fine, don't worry about it.
I've been thinking lately. Rinko's always leaning on you, isn't she？
Not just presents. I get all kinds of things from you...
But Rinko's like this, so I can't give much back... Honestly, do you still love Rinko？
Of course. I get how ▲小早川＊▲ feels, loud and clear.
I see... then I'm happy, I guess.
Only today. Let's say it's special because it's my birthday.
Haha, I see. Then I'll take your words honestly too.
Ah, geez. I shouldn't have said anything.
It's your birthday today, right？ Happy birthday.
...I'm happy, but you don't have to rush. I'm not going anywhere.
I just got excited. I've got a present too...
Yeah... You kind of know Rinko's taste.
...Thanks. The thought alone makes me happy.
(She didn't seem very happy with it...)
It's weird having someone outside my family celebrate me...
Yeah？ Then let's get you used to it. It's every year, after all.
But same goes for you！ I'm celebrating you right back on your birthday.
Haha, then I'd better get used to it too.
What's that, acting all cool. Enjoy that while it lasts.
I see. Go easy on me.
Happy birthday！ Will you accept a present？
Oh... this makes me so happy... I'll treasure it.
Whoa... They make stuff like this...
This... Oh, yeah. I'm happy about the thought, but...
(She didn't seem very happy with it...)
Don't mention it. Your birthday's only once a year.
But when you were picking the present, you were thinking about Rinko the whole time, right？
Yeah. So I had fun the whole time. I almost want to thank you.
Rinko has days where she thinks about nothing but you all day, you know？
Hehe, today too, I bet... all day.
It's your birthday today, right？ Here, a present.
If you're giving it, I'll take it... Hehe.
I'll take it, I guess. Throwing it out would be bad for the environment.
(She didn't seem very happy with it...)
But you didn't have to do that just for my birthday.
No？ You're my senior on the committee, and you've helped me out a lot.
I didn't say thanks yet. Thanks.
(Oh no！ It's ▲小早川＊▲'s birthday and I didn't get her a present...)
Sorry！ I actually didn't get you a birthday present！
(I'm the biggest idiot in the land！)
(Oh no！ It's ▲小早川＊▲'s birthday and I didn't get her a present...)
Oh... hehe. You look like you have business with Rinko？
Sorry！ I actually didn't get you a birthday present！
(I'm the biggest idiot in the land！)
(Oh no！ It's ▲小早川＊▲'s birthday and I didn't get her a present...)
Hehe, I came to pick it up myself. Just kidding.
Sorry！ I actually didn't get you a birthday present！
(I'm the biggest idiot in the land！)
(Come to think of it, today's ▲小早川＊▲'s birthday...)
Today's our anniversary, right. The day we started going out.
I got you a present, just in case.
Mm, Rinko too. Let's swap, then.
This is the one Rinko's been after forever...
Well, it's an anniversary... I'll take it...
(She didn't seem very happy with it...)
Next, I guess we get ready for next year. If we're doing it, I want to celebrate every year.
Never forget where you started, right？
Hey, do you remember what today is？
Of course. The anniversary of when we started going out, right？
I even got you a present.
Huh, really？ Then... swap with Rinko.
Amazing... This is something to remember the day by.
(She didn't seem very happy with it...)
It'd be nice if we can keep celebrating like this every year.
I bet these little happy, fun moments are what being a couple is all about.
Yeah, I'm already thinking about next year.
The anniversary of when we started going out.
Of course. I got you a present, too.
Hehe, actually... Rinko did too. Let's swap.
Wow, I didn't think you'd give me something like this...
Well, it's from you, so maybe I'll come to like it.
(She didn't seem very happy with it...)
It'd be nice to do this again next year.
Yeah. Next year, the year after...
Even when Rinko's an old lady？
Yeah. I wonder what kind of present I'll be giving then...
(Oh no. Isn't today the anniversary of when ▲小早川＊▲ and I started going out？)
Today's the anniversary of when we started going out.
But sorry, I didn't really get you a present...
It's fine... You don't have to worry about every little thing.
(Oh no. Isn't today the anniversary of when ▲小早川＊▲ and I started going out？)
What day is it today, again？
The anniversary of when we started going out... right？
But sorry, I didn't really get you a present...
Oh, I see. A little thoughtless, maybe... but whatever, it's fine.
(Oh no. Isn't today the anniversary of when ▲小早川＊▲ and I started going out？)
Quiz time. What day is it today？
Um... the anniversary of when we started going out.
But sorry, I didn't really get you a present...
I see... It's fine, as long as you remembered. I'm a teeny bit disappointed, though.
